Title: Verify successful login with valid credentials redirects to Dashboard
Precondition: The OrangeHRM QA instance is reachable. A registered user account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. The login page is loaded.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login form is displayed with a Username field, a Password field, and a 'Login' button | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the field labelled 'Username' → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' and displays no validation error | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the field labelled 'Password' → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters and displays no validation error | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The user is redirected to the Dashboard URL (/web/index.php/dashboard/index) and the Dashboard heading is displayed
Expected Result: The user is authenticated and lands on the Dashboard. A valid session is established.

Title: Verify 'Required' validation appears for both empty Username and Password on submit
Precondition: The login page is loaded and both the Username and Password fields are empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login form is displayed with empty Username and Password fields | 2. Leave the Username and Password fields blank and click the 'Login' button → Expected: The form does not submit and the user remains on the login page | 3. Observe the message beneath the Username field → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is displayed beneath the Username field | 4. Observe the message beneath the Password field → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is displayed beneath the Password field
Expected Result: Both fields display a 'Required' validation message and no authentication attempt is made.

Title: Verify password is not exposed in the URL or query string during login submission
Precondition: The login page is loaded over HTTPS. Browser developer tools Network panel is available.
Steps: 1. Open browser developer tools and select the Network tab, then navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login page loads over HTTPS and network requests are being captured | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field and 'admin123' into the Password field, then click 'Login' → Expected: The login request is submitted | 3. Inspect the login request in the Network panel → Expected: The credentials are sent via an HTTPS POST request body; the password does not appear in the request URL or any query string parameter | 4. Inspect the resulting browser address bar and page URL after login → Expected: The password value is not present anywhere in the URL
Expected Result: Credentials are transmitted securely over HTTPS in the request body with no password exposure in URLs or query strings.

Title: Verify unauthenticated direct access to Dashboard URL redirects to login
Precondition: No active session exists in the browser (all cookies cleared / logged out).
Steps: 1. Ensure no active session by clearing cookies or opening a fresh private browsing window → Expected: No authenticated session is present | 2. Navigate directly to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/dashboard/index → Expected: The browser does not display Dashboard widgets | 3. Observe the resulting page → Expected: The user is redirected to the login page (URL contains /auth/login) and the login form is displayed
Expected Result: Direct access to the Dashboard without a session redirects to the login page and exposes no dashboard content.

Title: Verify already-authenticated user visiting the login URL is routed to the Dashboard
Precondition: A registered user is currently authenticated with an active session (logged in as 'Admin').
Steps: 1. Log in at https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login and confirm the Dashboard is displayed → Expected: An active authenticated session exists and the Dashboard is shown | 2. In the same browser tab, navigate directly to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login form is not re-presented as an active form for an authenticated user | 3. Observe the resulting page → Expected: The user is routed to the Dashboard (URL contains /dashboard/index) using the existing session
Expected Result: An authenticated user hitting the login URL lands on the Dashboard rather than being asked to log in again.

Title: Verify Dashboard action after session expiry redirects to login
Precondition: A registered user is authenticated and viewing the Dashboard. The server session can be invalidated (via timeout or by clearing the session cookie).
Steps: 1. Log in as 'Admin' and remain on the Dashboard → Expected: The Dashboard is displayed with an active session | 2. Invalidate the session by deleting the session cookie in developer tools (simulating session expiry) → Expected: The session is no longer valid on the server | 3. Perform a Dashboard action that triggers a server request, such as clicking a navigation menu item → Expected: The request is not served with dashboard content | 4. Observe the resulting page → Expected: The user is redirected to the login page (URL contains /auth/login)
Expected Result: An action taken after session expiry redirects the user to the login page rather than serving protected content.
